Requirements You are not currently suffering from Bust.

You make the most of all of your spells, regardless of the risk. When a spell cast from a spell slot or your gambit’s aces would do nothing due to a critical success on a saving throw or a critical failure on an attack roll, you can use the Sleight effect of this feat.

Sleight You force a single target of the triggering spell to reroll their saving throw (granting the spell the Misfortune trait) or reroll the spell attack against a single target (granting the spell the Fortune trait). Turning your fortune around in such a way invites a karmic retribution however; you @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.arhOfryj6gDtqwZO]{Effect: Bust!} unless the saving throw becomes a critical failure or your attack becomes a critical hit.
